scope: Only figure assets actually referenced by math3-latex-1987-2009, math3-latex-2009-2019, and politics-latex-2003-2023 paper HTML; inline MathJax SVG and unreferenced asset files excluded.
method: Parsed paper HTML, inspected SVG image elements, reviewed associated PNG previews at original resolution. Browser file-policy restrictions were respected.

figures.alt: 函数 y=sin x 与面积 S_1、S_2 的示意图
figures.qualityAssessment: Crisp vector sine curve, labels and shaded areas legible.
keyInvariants: Keep y=sin x, O, t, π/2, S₁ and S₂; horizontal segment and two shaded regions retain their relative position.

figures.alt: 函数 y=x^2 与面积 S_1、S_2 的示意图
keyInvariants: Keep y=x², O, t, 1, S₁ and S₂; parabola, horizontal segment and shaded regions retain their relative position.

figures.alt: 1989年试卷IV第四题收益函数 R(x) 图形
figures.qualityAssessment: Graph itself is crisp; the PNG/SVG crop includes unrelated source text at the left edge, a crop issue.
keyInvariants: Keep R(x), x=2,4,6 and the plotted curve/dashed guides; do not change the labeled e-based values.
unreadableOrUncertain: Left edge contains cropped neighboring text; cropping is separate from blur.

figures.qualityAssessment: Graph itself is crisp; crop includes unrelated text fragments at the left edge.
keyInvariants: Keep x=-1/2, x=1 vertical dotted asymptote, y=2 horizontal dotted asymptote, O and curve branches.
unreadableOrUncertain: Left edge contains cropped neighboring text; cropping is separate from blur.

figures.alt: 试卷 V 第七题函数曲线图
keyInvariants: Keep axes, curve branches, dotted oblique line and all printed numeric labels.

figures.qualityAssessment: Crisp vector arcs and axis labels.
keyInvariants: Keep connected semicircle segments and x marks -3,-2,-1,O,1,2,3.

figures.alt: 第2题曲线段及区域 ABCD、ABOD 示意图
keyInvariants: Keep A(a,f(a)), B(a,0), C(0,f(a)), D, y=f(x), straight segments and curve.

figures.alt: 第4题阴影区域 D_uv，边界为半径 1、u 的圆弧和夹角 v
keyInvariants: Keep concentric quarter-circle boundaries x²+y²=1 and x²+y²=u², angle v and shaded D_uv.

figures.alt: 第4题已知函数 y=f(x) 的图形
keyInvariants: Keep y=f(x), open circles at x=0 and x=2, marks -1,0,1,2,3, and piecewise levels/curve.
Keep four separate choices A,B,C,D, their coordinate marks, open circles and each branch/plateau shape.

figures.alt: 第 2 题：二阶导函数 f″(x) 的图形
keyInvariants: Keep left branch tangent to x-axis, right branch and x/y axes.

figures.alt: 题1的导函数 \(f^{\prime}(x)\) 图形，坐标轴为 \(x,y\)。
figures.qualityAssessment: Crisp vector function curve and dotted vertical reference.
keyInvariants: Keep axes, dashed vertical line, all zero crossings, turning points and branch directions.

figures.qualityAssessment: Embedded JPEG diagram is pixelated; bullet text is small at SVG nominal width 194 px, so the relationships are hard to read.
keyInvariants: Preserve three overlapping ellipses, all three arrowed bullet groups, center intersection and arrow to future crisis; preserve Chinese labels only after verifying exact source text.
Color may separate the three groups, but overlap must not imply a different causal relationship.
unreadableOrUncertain: Some bullet characters are too small/aliased to certify from this preview; verify text from original source before replacement.

figures.qualityAssessment: Embedded JPEG Middle East map is visibly pixelated; small labels become unreadable at nominal SVG width 270 px.
keyInvariants: Preserve coastline and national boundaries, all country/place labels, 30°N and 40°E markers, north arrow, 600 km scale and legend; no added geopolitical claims.
Color may distinguish land, water and boundaries without emphasizing a political answer.
unreadableOrUncertain: Some place names cannot be certified at displayed size; validate against the original source or authoritative map before replacement.

figures.qualityAssessment: Embedded 109×103 JPEG cartoon is soft and tiny; the vertical caption on its right is unreadable.
keyInvariants: Preserve the original cartoon composition, tree, dark rounded ground and small adjacent figure/object; retain any caption only if verified from source.
Do not add symbolic objects or turn the cartoon into an interpretation of the answer choices.
unreadableOrUncertain: Right-side vertical writing and small details are illegible; do not guess them.

figures.qualityAssessment: Embedded 537×290 JPEG is a low-contrast scan; line-chart axes, month labels and both series are blurred.
keyInvariants: Preserve CPI diamond series versus PPI square series, chronological monthly x-axis, percentage y-axis, all plotted data points and legend; preserve crossing and peak relationships.
Color may distinguish the two series if legend remains explicit; do not infer exact numeric values from the blurry scan.
unreadableOrUncertain: Exact plotted percentages and some date labels cannot be certified from the preview; acquire verified data/source before precise redraw.

figures.qualityAssessment: Embedded 151×109 JPEG polar-bear photo is visibly soft and blocky, though the subject remains recognizable.
keyInvariants: Preserve one polar bear on a small piece of ice with surrounding water, pose and framing; avoid extra animals or environmental claims.
Color photo rendering is acceptable.
